text:
Priya K: Hey team — heads up, I'll be offline 03:00–11:00 UTC tomorrow for an early flight. Need someone to take primary for that window. I can keep secondary if needed but prefer not to.

Samir R: I can take primary for that block, happy to cover. Quick question: any ongoing investigations or customer-facing incidents I should know about?

Priya K: No active P1s. There was a noisy alert on inference-queue yesterday but it was mitigated (see incident thread). No open tickets tied to that. Customer impact is likely limited to a small spike in latencies for a subset of dedicated customers — we flagged them in ops-telemetry.

Jules: FYI the runbook steps for primary handoff are under /runbooks/oncall/handoff — but the checklist I'm using: update PagerDuty rotation, post here with coverage window, confirm access to the metrics dashboard, and share any ongoing shadow actions.

Samir R: Got it. I'm able to access the dashboards. Can you paste the PagerDuty transfer command? I want to make sure I do the transfer correctly.

Priya K: Use the CLI we use:
```
redwood oncall transfer --from priya.k --to samir.r --start 2025-06-12T03:00Z --end 2025-06-12T11:00Z --role primary
```
Once you run it, PagerDuty should send confirmation. Also add a Slack note in #eng-oncall and pin it to the thread.

oncall-bot: · User priya.k requested a rotation transfer. Pending approval from oncall-admins. (automated check: access OK, no conflicting windows)

Samir R: Running the CLI now.

Samir R: Done. I see the PagerDuty confirmation email. oncall-bot also shows the transfer pending, but the rotation updated in the web UI.

incident-bot: · Recent alert: inference-queue-consumer-error (resolved). Opened 2025-06-11T18:12Z, resolved 2025-06-11T18:25Z. Affected hosts: gpu-pool-3b. Tickets: none.

Zoe: Quick note on escalation: if anything P0/P1 hits while Priya is out, escalate to the oncall pager first, then ping the SRE leader (@jules) and the product incident lead. We had a missed ping last month where the non-primary didn't get looped in — want to avoid that.

Jules: I confirm I'll be available during that window as escalation lead. Also, Samir, please make sure to unmute the monitoring channel if you have muted it — the heartbeat alerts are suppressed for some folks.

Samir R: Unmuted now. I also checked dedicated-customer X's runbook note — if we see sustained latency > 400ms for 5+ minutes, follow the dedicated-fallback policy: roll to a lower-latency model variant and notify customers via status page draft.

Priya K: Thanks Samir. One more thing: if you need to escalate to infra, call out `region: us-west-2` in the first message so routing hits the right hardware team.

Samir R: Acknowledged. I'm posting the coverage note in #eng-oncall and pinning it.

Samir R: Posting: "Primary: Samir R (03:00–11:00 UTC), Secondary: Priya K (backup, reachable by DM), Escalation lead: Jules, Notes: watch inference-queue-consumer-error history, dedicated-customer X latency policy." Pinning now.

oncall-bot: · Rotation updated: primary=samir.r (2025-06-12T03:00Z -> 2025-06-12T11:00Z). Reminder: update personal calendar if you rely on rotation emails.

Priya K: Perfect — thanks Samir and everyone. I'll keep my phone on in case you need quick context but won't be available for troubleshooting.

Zoe: :thumbsup: Safe travels.

Samir R: All set. I'll handle any pages and tag folks per the escalation matrix. If anything odd pops up, I'll escalate to Jules immediately.

Jules: Thanks — appreciated. I'll be on standby for escalation.

Samir R: Quick follow-up — created a short pre-handoff checklist in the runbook: added creds refresh command and dashboard links. Copy below in case it helps: 
```
# pre-handoff checklist
1) Verify PagerDuty transfer confirmed
2) Open metrics: https://telemetry.redwood.io/dashboards/oncall
3) Test alert channel: /check-alerts --service inference
4) Confirm access to customer X's access log (s3://redwood-cx/access-logs)
```

Priya K: Awesome — that's thorough. Thanks for doing that.

oncall-bot: · Reminder scheduled: a huddle 10 minutes before handoff (02:50 UTC) will be posted if enabled.

Samir R: I'll join the 02:50 huddle. Closing the loop here — transfer complete and coverage confirmed.

Priya K: Closing from my side. Thanks all.

(Reaction summary: :thumbsup: from Zoe, :white_check_mark: from Jules)
